settings.title: Settings
settings.vendorCliSub: claude / codex — your own subscription, billed by the vendor
settings.hostsSub: sandbox · PTY · browser — separate permission scopes, every session passes the gate
settings.policySub: Per-action defaults — fail-closed, unknown kinds are denied
settings.companionSub: Watch, steer and answer approvals from your phone — owner-bound, redacted stream
settings.companionPhoneSub: Sign in with the SAME account → Companion. No pairing step — sessions are bound to your account.
settings.killSub: Stop everything this app can reach — two-step, audited
settings.reducedMotionSub: Turn off every micro-animation (the OS setting always wins)
settings.telemetrySub: None — this app ships no analytics or tracking code
kill.title: Stop everything?
kill.body: This rejects and disconnects what is listed below. It cannot be undone.
kill.scopeNote: PTY / relay sessions can't be started from this app yet — nothing of theirs is running here.
kill.failedRelay: companion stopped locally — the relay may not have confirmed it
app.name: Braavolabs
login.title: Sign in to Braavolabs
login.errLocked: Account temporarily locked. Try again later.
login.errRateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
login.errNetwork: Cannot reach the sign-in service. Check your connection and API URL.
keys.title: BYOK keys
keys.empty: No keys stored. Add one to use Direct.
keys.stored: Stored locally; never sent to the Braavolabs server. Direct sends it to the selected provider.
laneB.title: Lane-B · your CLIs
laneB.subtitle: Runs your own signed-in CLI. No vendor OAuth; output stays opaque.
laneB.launchHint: Run in your terminal for an interactive session:
mcp.title: MCP servers

mcp.name: Name
mcp.noTools: No tools — click a server to load its tools.
mcp.unreachable: MCP servers require the Braavolabs desktop host (run the Tauri app).
chat.cancelled: Compare cancelled. Work already in progress may still finish and incur costs.
chat.cancelTooLate: Compare already finished. Loading its result…
chat.cancelFailed: Could not cancel. The compare is still running; try again.
chat.voiceNote: Dictation uses your system's speech recognition; the text lands here and you send it.
chat.voiceDenied: Microphone or speech recognition is not allowed. Allow Braavolabs in System Settings › Privacy & Security.
chat.modelsNeeded: Load models for this company before sending.
chat.modelsUnavailable: Model options unavailable. Retry or choose automatic models.
chat.chooseModels: Select 1–{n} models. Effort controls only the selected candidate; synthesis uses the server default.
chat.noModels: No selectable models configured for this company.
chat.companyNeeded: Compare needs an active company. Enter a Company ID or switch to Cascade.
chat.localUnreachable: Ollama not reachable — is it running on {host}?
chat.noKey: No {provider} key stored. Add one under BYOK keys.
chat.unparsed: synthesis was not strict-JSON — raw fallback
inspector.title: Inspector
inspector.empty: Run a query to see cost, tier & confidence.
gov.policyHint: Which actions run automatically vs. ask you first. Unknown actions always ask (fail-closed).
gov.approveBody: Braavolabs is asking before it runs this action. Nothing runs until you approve.
gov.resolvedElsewhere: Already resolved from another device (companion or kill switch).
gov.kindDirectDispatch: Send your prompt to {provider} with your BYOK key
settings.themeSub: Follow the system or choose a light or dark appearance.
settings.preferenceUnsaved: This preference applies for this session but could not be saved for the next launch.
settings.languageFailed: The language could not be changed. Approvals or local preference storage may be unavailable. Try again.
chat.daemonOffline: The local daemon is not running. Start it with “braavo daemon start”, then choose Daemon again. Local and Direct still work.
chat.daemonNoModels: No usable model yet. Add a key with “braavo keys add <provider>” or start a local model, then choose Daemon again.
chat.daemonBusy: This chat is still answering. Wait for it to finish or stop it.
chat.daemonMissingKey: The daemon has no key for this provider: {detail}
chat.daemonModelRequired: Choose a model for this provider (PROVIDER/model).
chat.daemonStopped: Stopped. The partial answer was saved.
sessions.imported: Local history moved to the daemon: {n}
sessions.importPartial: Some local chats could not be moved to the daemon. They stay on this device and are retried at next launch.
sessions.daemonStore: Chat history is kept by the local daemon on this computer.
panel.loadFailed: The company panel could not be loaded.
panel.offline: Your company and its agents run on this computer through the local daemon. Start it with:
panel.createIntro: Name the company, pick the starter agents and they start working on this computer with your own keys or local models.
panel.hireIntro: Roles that are already staffed are skipped. Each agent gets a model suggested from your keys and local models.
panel.competitorUrls: Competitor pages to watch (one URL per line)
panel.releaseUrls: Release and policy pages to watch (one URL per line)
panel.needsSetup: Waiting for a key or a local model
panel.modelRequired: choose a model for {provider} on its card
panel.needsUrlsHint: not scheduled yet; hire again with "{field}" filled in
panel.selectAgent: Select an agent to change its model, effort or state.
panel.noModels: No model from your keys or local models yet
panel.modelInvalid: Choose a model, or type PROVIDER/model.
panel.providersNeedModel: Key present, model not known for: {providers}. Use Other to type one.
panel.noFindings: No findings yet. They appear here after a watch routine sees a change.
panel.findingsTruncated: Showing the most recent part of the findings.

panel.err.timeout: The daemon did not answer in time.

panel.err.missing-key: No key for this provider on the daemon.
panel.err.model-required: Choose a model for this provider.
